scores.tell: Cauldron fills the card and is cropped by the bottom edge. The stone floor is busy behind it, and the pink stripes are small. The real cards show a smaller hero with more air.
The hero is a tiny table and stools lost in a full meadow scene. It reads as a landscape, not an object. Real cards have a dominant hero.
The train is cropped at the left and bottom, and the track and desert scene compete with it. The scene is wide and has no centered single hero.
Same tiny table and stools in a busy meadow as c106. The hero is small, with a lot of background detail.
The UFO is tilted and centered with comfortable margins. The concentric rings behind it frame it as a radial backdrop. It matches the whistle and carousel cards.
The calculator is tilted, fills the card well and has even margins. The pattern backdrop is quiet. It closely matches the real cards.
The tower fills the card height and nearly touches the top edge. Clouds crowd the sides. It is a tall scene, not a centered object with a clean backdrop.
The clock is centered and fills the card with tight side margins of about 40 px. The stripes are a clean backdrop. It is slightly large and static, with no tilt.
This is nearly identical to c131: a large, centered, front-facing clock with tight side margins and no tilt.
The cat sits centered and tall, as in the grade 1 lesson. The framing is fine, but the table and wall add a diagonal clutter that real cards use less.
